title: Dynamic-memory quiz with safeguarded CodeHelp support
summary: Students complete a 2.5-hour formative C++ quiz on dynamic memory and linked lists with access to a safeguarded LLM chatbot. The quiz combines ten multiple-choice items with an open programming task, unlimited attempts, autograder feedback, and optional CodeHelp questions that do not reveal solutions.

sources.title: Understanding Optimal Interactions Between Students and A Chatbot During A Programming Task
sources.evidence_quote: The quizzes occur before the corresponding lab is due; students are given 2.5 hours to complete the quiz, they have unlimited attempts in open-ended questions.

assessment.summary: Answer ten multiple-choice questions and implement the Big Three for a class that owns a dynamically allocated array.
student_actions: Implement a copy constructor, assignment operator, and destructor.
Run tests and revise over unlimited attempts.
Ask CodeHelp for guidance when needed.

student_role.description: Students may ask CodeHelp for guidance; safeguards remove direct code solutions.

grading.method: Codio test cases report whether the open programming response passes.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
